name: [MATCHMAKING]🏀Ultimate Basketball
desc:
🏀 WELCOME TO ULTIMATE BASKETBALL 🏀
A fast-paced Anime style Basketball game bringing fresh mechanics and unique features to the ROBLOX basketball scene. Built for players who love skill, style, and nonstop action. 🔥

🔥 UPDATES ARE LIVE 🔥
Be among the first to play new content by hitting NOTIFY staying locked in for future drops.

🎽 CUSTOMIZATION 🎽
Unlock Ball Trails, Ability's, and basketball goal effects to stand out on the court!

🎮 PLAYER FRIENDLY
Controls are easy to learn for new and casual players
Playable on all platforms

🛑 FAIR PLAY ONLY
Cheaters are detected and banned. Keep it clean.

👍 SUPPORT THE GAME
Leave a like and favorite to help Ultimate Basketball grow!
